fields.System.Title: RET-503 — Return reason analysis
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want returns grouped by reason and by disposition outcome, so
that I can tell which returns are our fault.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then returns are grouped by customer-stated reason and by
  • inspection grade.
  • - Given the report, then it separates warehouse-caused returns — wrong item, wrong
  • quantity, damaged in packing — from other causes.
  • - Given a warehouse-caused return, then it can be traced to the pick and pack records
  • that produced the original shipment.
  • - Given the trend, then it is plotted over time so improvement is visible.
  • - Given the split, then the proportion restocked, repaired, returned to supplier, and
  • scrapped is shown.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, outbound |
| Tables | return rate projection, inspection, disposition |
| Risks | Warehouse-caused returns invisible among all returns |
| Tests | integration |
